label: Relevant own-being sources respect the essence-esse identity dictionary
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For each participant x and each distinct actual OwnBeing c that causes its esse, the represented esseOf c equals essenceOf c in the same q3 profile. This is an open application dictionary restricted to relevant causal sources, not a definition of OwnBeing or a converse from identity to subsistence. Lean does not impose it on arbitrary supplied profile maps.
